title: feat(app-shell): Connect an AI Assistant opens with what a connected assistant can do, in plain words
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao4R5vgzn4JR1Ewtt4rWD5cr)_

Part of #30898

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「连接 AI 助手」页最上方新增一张卡片，用两句白话说明连接后 AI 助手能做什么（以你的身份查找、新建、修改、删除你有权操作的记录，并运行系统操作），再给三条可一键复制的示例请求，并提示先试第一条来确认连接成功。地址卡片和 Claude Code 步骤不再出现 MCP、OAuth 等协议词，只有客户端自己的菜单或表单里用到的地方保留。各客户端里「改用 API 密钥」的提示现在指向「高级：脚本与 CI」区域。
- 为什么改：这个页面的读者不懂 MCP；连接前要先知道助手能为自己做什么，连接后要知道先问什么来确认连上了。
- 风险与回滚：只改页面文案和一张展示卡片，不改服务端行为和连接步骤本身。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ConnectAgentWidget.tsx` 顶部新卡片，`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts` 和 `en.ts` 的 `connectAgent.capabilities`，测试文件末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：本地部署打开 设置 → 连接 AI 助手，第一张卡片是「连接后，AI 助手能做什么」，下面是三条示例请求和复制按钮；往下的地址卡片标题是「本系统的连接地址」，不再提 OAuth 2.1。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ui 席 2 对照 head `bcbc29ec` 的 diff 复核：15 个文件、+342 / −102，无受治理路径。「连接 AI 助手」页顶部新增一张卡：用两句白话说明连接后助手能查找、新建、修改、删除你有权操作的记录并运行操作，始终以你的身份；附三条可复制的示例请求和「先试第一条」的提示（页面尚不能判断是否已连接，所以对所有人显示）。地址卡、Claude Code 步骤和关闭状态不再出现 MCP / OAuth，协议词只留在客户端自己的菜单和表单里；API 密钥提示指向「高级：脚本与 CI」。十个语言包同步，繁体由简体生成。阿语一条旧文案断言改为 toContain，因标题已改写。遗留：Expected 2（已连接的助手与最近调用，等 #30894）和页头副标题。CI 全绿，Clause-② no，不欠契约复审。同意落地。

## What changes

- `ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`: a new first card, "What your AI assistant can do here". It holds two plain sentences (look up, create, change and delete the records you may, run actions, always as you), three example requests each with a copy button, and a line saying to try the first one, because an answer listing your objects shows the connection works. The address card follows, then the client picker, as before.
- Copy without protocol words (Expected 3): the address card title and body, the Claude Code step, and the turned-off empty state now say "connection address", "sign in in the browser" and "AI assistant connections". MCP, OAuth and Streamable HTTP remain only where a client's own menu or form uses them: Codex's "MCP servers" menu, WorkBuddy's "Configure MCP" button, QwenWork's Streamable HTTP transport choice, the Transport field values, and the operator setting `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED` named in the turned-off state.
- The four hints that fall back to an API key (Codex, WorkBuddy, Doubao Work, QwenWork) said "create a key below". The key form now sits in the collapsed Advanced section, so they name it: "(create one under Advanced: scripts and CI below)".
- i18n: seven new keys under `connectAgent.capabilities` and the reworded strings, in all ten packs; `zh-Hant.ts` regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`.
- Root changeset `.changeset/30898-connect-agent-what-it-can-do.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`: patch).

## Tests

`ConnectAgentWidget.keyName-13355.test.tsx` gets a new describe:
- §1: the capabilities card comes before the address, with body, three example requests each beside a copy button, and the try-first line.
- §2: every pack carries the seven capability strings, and none is an English copy.
- §3: no `connectAgent.*` string in any pack contains MCP, OAuth or Streamable HTTP, outside the four client-form keys.
- §4: each fallback hint contains that pack's `advanced.title`.

Ablation: putting `en.ts` back to its state before this change fails §2, §3 and §4 (§3 lists `en disabled.title`, `url.title`, `url.body` and `claudeCode.body`).

Two existing i18n pins moved with the copy:
- `residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` pinned the old Arabic turned-off title verbatim. It now checks that the title keeps the pack's deployment word, `في هذا النشر`, which is what that case claims.
- The German hints name Advanced without „…“ quotes, so `de-quote-pairing-3876`'s pinned pair count stays 107.

## Leftovers

- Expected 2, the "connected: which assistant, last call" line, reads the same per-person records as #30894, which is blocked. This PR ships only the nothing-connected-yet part: the try-first line, shown to everyone and never derived from a click.
- Expected 3, outside this PR's surface: the page header subtitle is page metadata in `packages/mcp/src/connect-ui.ts` ("Give any MCP-capable AI client governed access … row-level security."). Its translations live in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations` (`pages.connect_agent.subtitle`, source-hashed). It still uses protocol words and goes with Expected 2.

## Verification

Head `bcbc29ec`. The branch was restarted on `main` `115a43ad`, after PR #30973 merged as `d9d3eb70`, and the change was cherry-picked cleanly. A full `pnpm build` on that base ran 119/119.

<details><summary>Live check on a local deployment (showcase with the fresh flag, console Vite dev, admin and member)</summary>

- Before (`main` with #30897): the page opens with "This system's MCP endpoint" and a paragraph on OAuth 2.1 and row-level security, and no sentence says what an assistant can do. As admin and as member alike, the widget plus header carried 7 protocol-word hits on the Claude tab and 8 on Codex.
- After: the first card is "What your AI assistant can do here", with the two sentences, then "List the objects I can see." / "Count how many records each of those objects has." / "What actions can I run here, and what does each one do?" with copy buttons, then the try-first line. Below it comes "This system's connection address".
- Protocol-word hits after: 2 on Claude, Cursor and Doubao Work, both from the page header subtitle (a leftover, see above). Codex has 4: the header plus its "MCP servers" menu and Streamable HTTP field. WorkBuddy has 3 (its "Configure MCP" button) and QwenWork 3 (its transport choice). Admin and member read the same.
</details>

<details><summary>Local tests and gates</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts` → 100 files, 1693 passed, 13 skipped (widget file 16/16)
- app-shell `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` → exit 0. eslint on `packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/` → 0 errors (3 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` → zh-Hant.ts current. `pnpm check:test-source-alias` → OK.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 38 commands on bcbc29ec, and all 38 exit 0. That includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files passed). `--ran` with exit codes: 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived zero), 0 UNRUN.
</details>
